about_the_game:
Decorate your dream home one adorable sticker at a time! 🏡✨
Welcome to Cozy Sticker Home, a warm and fuzzy little world where every sticker makes your space cuter, cozier, and totally YOU! 💕🍄

Collect charming sticker packs 🎁, peel each one with a satisfying pop 🫶, and place them wherever your heart wants 💫. Turn empty rooms into cozy corners filled with pillows 🛋️, plants 🌿, pastries 🧁, sparkles ✨, and pure joy.

Unlock new rooms 🚪, find surprise stickers 🎨, and decorate freely with no rules, no timers, no stress 🌙. Just soft vibes, gentle creativity, and comfort.

Whether you are a décor lover 💖, a sticker addict 💌, or someone who simply needs a peaceful moment to smile 😊, this is your cozy little sanctuary.

Key Features

🌟 Hundreds of adorable stickers to collect, peel, and place
🌼 Cute themed rooms to unlock, each waiting for your magic touch
🌙 Relaxing and pressure free gameplay
🍃 Soft visuals and calming music for instant cozy vibes
📸 Share your sweetest room designs with friends and spread the cuteness
